config._comment: Every setting here is a choice the project owner may change. Each one is documented, with its alternatives and its PROVISIONAL status, in docs/decisions.md (section 'Provisional resolutions'). Changing a value and re-running `python -m src.build` regenerates every derived artifact deterministically.

_table.nulls: null = value does not exist for this pair (see source_flags); 0 = measured/reconstructed absence
_table.row: one ordered pair (pre, post) of distinct head neurons; pre = stimulated / presynaptic / sender, post = responding / postsynaptic / receiver

anat_chem_white.definition: chemical synapse count pre->post in NemaNode n2u export; null if either neuron absent from the dataset
anat_chem_white.paper: White JG, Southgate E, Thomson JN, Brenner S. The structure of the nervous system of the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Phil Trans R Soc Lond B 314, 1-340 (1986). doi:10.1098/rstb.1986.0056

anat_chem_white_jsh.definition: chemical synapse count pre->post in NemaNode jsh export; null if either neuron absent from the dataset
anat_chem_white_jsh.paper: White JG, Southgate E, Thomson JN, Brenner S. The structure of the nervous system of the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Phil Trans R Soc Lond B 314, 1-340 (1986). doi:10.1098/rstb.1986.0056
